d: Lodges on view of the Tiber in the apartments of Vitellia. Vitellia and Sesto.

First, the atrium of the temple of Jupiter Stator, a place already famous for the meetings of the Senate; back, part of the Roman forum, magnificently adorned with bows, obelisks and trophies; on the sides, seen far away from Mount Palatine and a large part of the sacred way; on the face, outward appearance of the Capitol, and magnificent road for which it ascends. In the above-mentioned atrium will be Publius, the Roman Senators and legates of the provinces subject, destined to present to the senate the annual imposed tributes.
Delicious retreat in the imperial stay on Palatine Hill. Titus and Publius with a sheet.
Six, with the badge of the conspirators on the mantle.
Annio, then Servilia, then Publius with Guards.
Earthly gallery adorned with statues, corresponding to gardens. Titus and Servilia.
Sixth, Vitellia, Tito, Servilia, and Annio with the mantle of Sesto.
Closed room, with doors, chair and table, with top to write. Titus and Publius.
Tito, Publius, Sixth and Custodians. Sixth, he just walked in, stopped.
Vitellia, coming out the opposite door, recalls Publius, who followed Tito.
Vitellia, and then Annio and Servilia from different parts.

Magnificent place, which introduces to vast amphitheatre, of which for several arches discovered the inner part. You will already see in the arena the Conspiracy's Conspiracy, condemned to the fairs. In the time that you sing the choir, Tito comes out, preceded by 'Littori, surrounded by' Senators and Patrizi Romans, and followed by 'Portoriani; indi Annio and Servilia from different parts.
Publius and Sixtus between 'Littori, then Vitellia, and sayings.
